class.name: ToastOptions
class.description: Every property has a default value, so only the ones that should differ from the defaults need to be set. Create one instance and reuse it for multiple toasts if the settings stay the same.

members.member: How the toast sound is played: once, silently, or in a loop.
How long the toast stays on screen.
Absolute path to a PNG, JPG or GIF displayed in the toast. Empty means no icon. SVG is not supported by Windows toast images.
How the icon is cropped (square or circle).
If [code]true[/code], toasts currently displayed or queued by this app are hidden first so the new toast appears immediately.
System sound to play. Custom audio files are not reliably available to unpackaged desktop apps, so system sounds are preferred.
